# biznetgio_gpu_keypair (Resource)

GPU SSH keypair. The key material is generated by BiznetGIO; the private key is only returned once at creation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "biznetgio" {}

resource "biznetgio_gpu_keypair" "example" {
  name = "neo-gpu-key"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Keypair name. Changing it replaces the keypair.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Keypair id.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) Generated private key, shown only once. If the API does not return it, only the portal can show it.
- `public_key` (String) Generated public key.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import biznetgio_gpu_keypair.example <keypair_id>
```
